title: The Centennial Pyrotechnics
logline: A habitat festival coordinator insists on launching antique ceremonial fireworks that have turned chemically unstable, defying the station safety marshal who orders them dumped into space.

roles.description: Promoter of the habitat's centennial jubilee; desperate to stage the historic fireworks to avoid forfeiting municipal performance bonds.
Habitat life-support and fire safety officer; horrified by the blast potential of century-old perchlorate munitions.
A wealthy private curio dealer offering to buy the volatile ordnance intact for a private vault.
An unpressurized external munitions locker mounted on the habitat's outer hull.
The ceremonial firing platform configured to launch the centennial salvo into the local nebula.

public_situation: Crowds gather across {system}'s concourses for the centennial jubilee fireworks display, while safety inspectors order an emergency lockdown of the outer launch pylon.
private_truth: The antique ceremonial charges have suffered casing corrosion over ninety years of thermal cycling, making them liable to detonate inside the pylon rather than in orbit.

beats.public_change: Festival banners unfurl along the promenade while emergency Klaxons flash amber near the launch platform.

missions.reason: The marshal needs a pilot equipped with thermal sensors to scan the exterior fireworks locker to assess chemical degradation before crowds mass.
missions.private_fact: She has already prepared a summary condemnation order but fears the festival director will sue her department for venue losses.

beats.public_change: The station council orders the jubilee celebration to proceed on schedule unless formal hazardous material warrants are served.

missions.reason: The director contracts the pilot to transport the ceremonial electronic firing triggers to the pylon before the safety marshal seals the access airlock.
missions.private_fact: He has spent eighty percent of the ticket proceeds on non-refundable musical acts and faces bankruptcy if the salvo is cancelled.

missions.reason: The curio dealer hires the pilot to collect sample casings from the outer locker to authenticate the century-old manufacturer stamps.
missions.private_fact: He plans to display the unexploded ordinance in his penthouse suite regardless of station safety codes.

beats.public_change: The festival countdown begins as hundreds of observation craft crowd the perimeter around the launch pylon.

missions.reason: The marshal hires the pilot to carry remote emergency jettison thrusters to the pylon to handle the volatile warheads.
missions.private_fact: The marshal is terrified that any jostling will trigger a catastrophic hull breach across the viewing decks.

player_choice.prompt: The remote firing console is in the pilot's cockpit. The pilot must choose how to dispose of the volatile centennial pyrotechnics.

options.label: Jettison the unstable fireworks into deep space to protect the habitat
Fire the ceremonial salvo into orbit, risking casing blowback
Quietly offload the intact warheads to the private collector

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot dumps the fireworks into deep space, preventing any habitat explosion.
resolutions.summary: The unstable ordnance detonates safely in the void. {role:safety_marshal} secures the habitat, but {role:festival_director} is bankrupted by refunds.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot jettisoned unstable holiday fireworks, saving a habitat viewing lounge from disaster.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fires the display as scheduled, creating a spectacular but damaging blast.
resolutions.summary: The display dazzles the festival crowd, but a backfiring mortar cracks the outer pylon. {role:festival_director} celebrates while repairs mount.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot ignited century-old fireworks over {system}, blistering the hull for a holiday crowd.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot diverts the hazardous warheads to the antique collector's vault.
resolutions.summary: {role:antique_collector} spirits away the antique munitions. The jubilee goes dark without an explanation, and {role:festival_director} flees with the ticket receipts.
The corroded charges cook off during pre-launch warmup, destroying {role:launch_pylon}. {role:safety_marshal} faces public inquiry.

loose_threads.detail: The original colonial bill of lading for the fireworks displays an unfulfilled indemnity bond held by a central mining bank.
The packing crates for the fireworks carry stencils matching an unrecorded munitions batch produced by a forgotten border foundry.

radio_hooks: Jubilee organizers promise historic orbital pyrotechnics display to mark centennial charter day in {system}.
Habitat fire marshals urge caution as municipal inspectors review exterior launch pylon readiness.
Crowds flock to habitat observation cupolas as countdown begins for centennial fireworks.

voice_direction.festival_director: Flamboyant, loud, and uses dramatic showmanship to dodge technical questions. Never admits the display was not insured.
voice_direction.safety_marshal: Tense, blunt, and repeatedly quotes industrial hazard thresholds. Avoids any discussion of public relations.
voice_direction.antique_collector: Soft-spoken, elegant, and speaks with languid detachment. Never mentions where the collection is housed.
